name: neural-weights-cjk
phase: NAME RESERVATION (0.0.1). The graph and vocabulary below are the v8-cjk-kana 24k candidate (2026-09-06, #2165); the first functional release ships with the next mailwoman minor once the ja-jp / zh-cn overlays exist.

format.model: ONNX fp32 (opset 17), inputs char_ids int64 (batch, sequence, 7) + attention_mask int64 (batch, sequence), output logits (batch, sequence, 49). No SentencePiece tokenizer: the encoder is one unit per Unicode code point with a ±3 character window over the sealed vocabulary in char-vocab.json (2,337 entries, <pad> 0, <unk> 1, code-point order).

files_md5.$comment: The candidate artifacts' md5s — what a materialized package is verified against.

training.run: v8-cjk-kana seed 42, 24,000 steps, batch 256, bf16, cosine, from scratch (corpus-python/src/mailwoman_train/configs/v8-cjk-kana.yaml)
training.corpus: v8-cjk-kana-2026-09-06 overlay: the v8-jp-kana-2026-09-06 JP corpus (2,000,000 train rows, Overture-JP, five registers — native, arabic_chome, compact_folded, designator, kana_municipality) plus 126 CN organizational-unit rows; source mixture overture-jp 0.98 / coarse-placer-cn-units 0.02

jp_board_20000.$comment: Held-out municipalities, coordinate-acceptability at 15 km via the municipality centroid table (corpus-python/scripts/score_jp_probe_board.py --label-set stage3-cjk), on the pre-registered v8-jp-full-2026-08-04 board. PyTorch read; the shared head (v8-cjk-full) read 0.9653 / 0.9757 on the same instrument.
jp_board_20000.note: かすみがうら市 (823 held-out rows) fails 0 (the shared head failed 598); 中新川郡上市町 fails 121 of 136 (the shared head 66) — the model closes the municipality at the inner 市. On the v8-jp-kana-2026-09-06 board the 1,127 kana_municipality rows read 1,125 gold-exact.

cn_board_14.$comment: locality_unit span exact-match, PyTorch per-unit argmax; the shared head read 10 (PyTorch) / 12 (served, Viterbi).

model_lineage: 0.0.1: v8-cjk-full step-024000 (fp32 ONNX md5 e14ef4c426dabb22e9433ab04b584d48). Decision record: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-cjk-serving-path.md; receipts on #1176, #2034, #2164.
notes: One CJK package a consumer installs as a unit (#1177 Phase B): Japanese and Chinese ride one 49-label head; ja-jp and zh-cn data-only overlays follow.
Channel-free by contract (D5): no postcode-anchor, gazetteer, country or evidence channels; the graph declares only char_ids and attention_mask.

The locale hint routes a cjk character class to ja-JP; until the ja-jp overlay exists, load this package explicitly: NeuralAddressClassifier.loadFromWeights({ modelPath, charVocabPath, modelCardPath }).
